name: Pharmacology
boundaries: Pharmacology: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal blood–brain barrier shuttle for arbitrary macromolecular cargos
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by PHA-05. The “98 percent” claim was not verified and was not imported.

original_dispositions.original_title: General oral bioavailability for folded peptides and proteins
original_dispositions.reason: Added as PHA-11. The first pass had set this aside as formulation. The accessibility standard justifies a separate concept. The “30–50 percent” figure is not used as a criterion.

original_dispositions.original_title: Predictive model of idiosyncratic and human-specific toxicity from structure alone
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by PHA-03 for immune-mediated idiosyncratic injury and by PHA-02 for general pre-human prediction of major toxicity. The “95 percent” and “50 percent attrition” figures were not traced and are not used.

original_dispositions.original_title: One binding site that disables all major ABC and SLC efflux transporters without affecting normal physiology
original_dispositions.reason: ABC transporters include P-glycoprotein at physiological barriers, so a universal off-switch collides with normal distribution, including the barrier in PHA-05. Clinical inhibitors have also failed to become oncology practice: Yu, Ocana, and Tannock wrote that, despite promising preclinical and early clinical data, they have yet to find a role in oncologic practice (Cancer and Metastasis Reviews, 2013;32:211–227, doi:10.1007/s10555-012-9402-8, https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10555-012-9402-8). Author names are taken from the reference list of a later PMC review; the Springer record supplied the abstract sentence. Phenotypic persistence remains PHA-08 and is not this pump problem.

Capecitabine, hypoxia-activated prodrugs, and antibody-drug-conjugate linkers already show narrow versions. A universal lock for arbitrary disease signatures would be powerful, and the evidence assembled here shows a family of specific chemistries, not a missing general principle at the calibration bar. Conditional degrader activation remains a technical strategy inside PHA-01’s sources, not a separate concept.

original_dispositions.original_title: Molecular reset of opioid tolerance and dependence without loss of analgesia
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by PHA-10, which was amended so that a reset preserving full μ-agonist efficacy still has to remove respiratory depression and reinforcement.

original_dispositions.original_title: Master switch for selective clearance of senescent cells
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by PHA-09. Senolysis is recorded there as one unproven route. Farr and colleagues, 2024, is the new human evidence. A separate senolytic entry would split one aging concept in two.

original_dispositions.original_title: One neutralizer for entire classes of xenobiotics and biological toxins
original_dispositions.reason: Organophosphate bioscavengers, chelators, and antivenoms are class-specific tools. One molecule that catalytically detoxifies organophosphates, heavy metals, cyanotoxins, and every venom component was not supported as a single mechanism. The claim stays an unbounded wish list.

original_dispositions.original_title: Pharmacological trigger for scarless epimorphic regeneration in adult mammals
original_dispositions.reason: Added as PHA-12. It overlaps PHA-06 and is not the same: PHA-06 replaces a cell type, PHA-12 rebuilds patterned multi-tissue structure.

original_dispositions.original_title: Real-time closed-loop pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic control encoded in the medicine
original_dispositions.reason: Added as PHA-13. Device-based insulin loops are acknowledged as a different, already advancing technology. The missing result is the medicine itself, and generality beyond glucose is stated as uncertain.

reconciliation_change_log.change: 2026-11-01. Initial note. PHA-01 through PHA-10 selected and sourced.

reconciliation_change_log.reason: The first-pass concepts are unchanged in identity.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended PHA-01 with the 2026 approved-target count and an explicit boundary against prodrug logic.
Amended PHA-02 with the 2026 artificial-intelligence perspective and a refusal of the historical accuracy and attrition percentages.
Amended PHA-05 with the 2021 Japanese approval of pabinafusp alfa for Hunter syndrome and a refusal of the unverified “98 percent” figure.
Amended PHA-06 to flag patterned regeneration as PHA-12.
Amended PHA-08 to separate efflux-pump inhibition from persister killing.
Amended PHA-09 with the 2024 dasatinib-plus-quercetin bone trial and an explicit statement that senolysis is one route inside this concept.
Amended PHA-10 so opioid tolerance reset remains inside the same coupling problem.
Added PHA-11, oral systemic exposure of folded peptides and proteins.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Reliable oral access for that class is a scale change and oral semaglutide does not supply it.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added PHA-12, a pharmacological trigger for scarless regrowth of complex adult structures.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The 2025 ear-pinna and 2026 digit results are real and still far from the human scope.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added PHA-13, a medicine that holds its own therapeutic window, distinguished from device-based insulin loops.

Rejected the historical efflux, universal-antidote, and universal-prodrug entries for the reasons in the disposition. Recorded that the historical list’s five source attributions do not match the documents at those locations.
